characters.Walk: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel art animation source. Use the attached existing scouts as CHARACTER IDENTITY reference only. TWO chibi woodland scouts: black-haired boy with green leaf cap green tunic brown boots; auburn bob-haired girl with tan beret orange scarf brown boots. Crisp chunky pixel art, 4px clusters, dark outline, no gradients. Transparent background. EXACT GRID 5 columns by 4 rows, twenty frames. Top TWO rows are TEN boy frames in reading order; bottom TWO rows TEN girl frames. Every cell SAME canvas, plenty of transparent margin (20% padding). NO sprite may touch or cross a cell edge. Fixed camera SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT, full body, consistent head size and scale across ALL frames. Same imaginary ground baseline in each cell. No balls, circles, platform, text, grid lines, FX or scenery. First frame of each character is upright neutral to calibrate proportions. ANIMATION: ten-frame smooth walking cycle, alternating steps and arm swing, last pose loops to first.

arena: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D woodland game arena kit. Crisp chunky 16-bit pixel art, dark outlines, warm oak and moss green palette matching enchanted woodland scouts. TWO SEPARATE objects on a transparent canvas with ample empty margin, no overlap: upper third a long perfectly HORIZONTAL SIDE VIEW ancient oak balancing plank, straight flat grass/moss top surface and flat underside, lovingly detailed bark grain, vine wraps and tiny mushrooms at ends, rope lashings, strong readable silhouette, aspect ratio about 9:1. Bottom half centered: a perfectly ROUND enchanted wooden seed sphere used as a fulcrum, cross-section carved oak swirling grain, moss patches on sides, amber glowing runic cracks, subtle leaf ornaments that do not distort circular perimeter. Sprite object not realistic render. No characters no text no landscape no cast shadow. Full objects entirely visible away from edges. This kit is designed to crop into two standalone PNG sprites.
